manual_review_reason: KXCI's official Music Department page explicitly accepts music from all over the world and authorizes MP3 or WAV download-link submissions through a first-party Music Department email action, with an optional national or international CD or vinyl route. The digital destination is Cloudflare-protected in passive retrieval and must not be decoded, guessed or inferred. A human must open the official page normally, select one suitable MarcsMusic release, confirm whether standalone singles are accepted because the page describes digital albums, prepare artwork, tracklist, timings, release date, genre, similar artists, explicit-language disclosure, biography and contact details, and confirm unpublished AI-origin and release-window requirements. KXCI receives more than 500 submissions weekly. Use one authorized route only and stop if authentication, CAPTCHA, payment, consent or other protected controls appear.
